summary.text: Parents can access ICA e-Service when it resumes, or email ICA if there is an urgency.

steps.name: Access ICA e-Service
steps.text: Parents should access ICA e-Service when the system resumes.

items: Parents should access ICA e-Service when the system resumes.

steps.name: Email ICA if urgent
steps.text: If there is an urgency, parents may email ICA for assistance.

items: If there is an urgency, parents may email ICA at ICA_Birth_RBD@ica.gov.sg for assistance.
